request.style: English, male baritone solo, orchestral strings, french horn, timpani, low cello, somber and dramatic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A prophet spoke to his companion
Strike me, he requested kindly
The man refused the voice of God
A lion found him and killed him
Another man obeyed the word
He struck the prophet with a wound

[Pre-Chorus]
The prophet stood upon the road
Disguised with ash upon his eyes
He waited for the king of Israel
To pass along the dusty way

[Chorus]
Your servant went into the battle
A prisoner was brought to you
Guard this man, they said to you
If he escapes, your life is paid
Or a talent of silver
While I was busy here and there
The man has disappeared from sight

[Verse]
The king of Israel spoke aloud
That is your sentence, he declared
You have pronounced it yourself now
The verdict rests upon your head
The prophet pulled the bandage off
And Ahab saw the prophet face

[Chorus]
Your servant went into the battle
A prisoner was brought to you
Guard this man, they said to you
If he escapes, your life is paid
Or a talent of silver
While I was busy here and there
The man has disappeared from sight

[Bridge]
This is what the Lord declares
You set the devoted man free
Your life shall stand for his life
Your people for his people

[Outro]
Sullen and angry in his heart
The king went home to Samaria
